comment: The Pyodide release the guide's Run buttons use for @python blocks: real CPython compiled to WebAssembly. The page downloads these files from `base` the first time a reader runs a granted @python block, checks each one's sha256 before using it, and hands the bytes to the sandboxed worker (which has no network). scripts/fetch-pyodide downloads the same files for scripts/check-browser.mjs. Version 314.0.7 is CPython 3.14, the Python the guide's examples were verified with. To update: change version and base, run `scripts/fetch-pyodide --update`, then run the checks.
